column3: Original Harbor, a compact technical street circuit through a Florida waterfront harbor district: a marina full of white yachts and wooden piers, low modern harbor buildings and warehouses with flat roofs, palm-lined streets, a small sponsor pavilion by the start line, turquoise water wrapping around the district

Harbor Express, a long fast coastal road circuit on a narrow strip of land between the open ocean and a harbor: the two long straights are a seafront boulevard with guard rails and tall street lamps and an inland service road past warehouses and shipping containers, with tight hairpins at each end; beaches, breakwaters and sailboats along the shore

Smoky Ridge, a closed mountain circuit climbing through forested hills: a winding two-lane road through dense oak and pine forest, rocky outcrops, a ridgeline with long views, layers of hazy blue mountains in the distance, a small start pavilion in a clearing, no ocean
